screens.name: Customer Search
screens.purpose: Search by name or email; the matching-results and no-results views are distinct states on /customers.

screens.name: Customer Detail
screens.purpose: View a customer, edit name/email in local demo state, or return to search.

screens.name: Customer Not Found State
screens.purpose: Show a not-found message for an unknown customer ID and offer a return link.

screens.name: Customer Edit State
screens.purpose: Edit the selected customer's name and email, then save or cancel.

screens.name: Customer Search — No Results State
screens.purpose: Show a no-results status while retaining the search form so the user can amend the query.
entryPoints: SCR-001 Search action when zero customers match
screens.stateNotes: This is a meaningful visual state on the same /customers route, not a separate route. The search input and button remain available.

notes: SCR-003 is a distinct UI state on the same route, not a different route.
SCR-004 is the edit form state on the same detail route, opened by the Edit control.
